notes.title: Big Update v1.2.0 and New Character coming soon!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We have all the songs' DATA REMASTERED to be more accurate and fun!!! ːsteamhappyː
What's new:
- Songs' data remastered. 
- Some songs have become a 4-stars difficulty to give hardcore players more room to enjoy.
- Gift items will provide different unique buffs in the song battle.
- H-Scenes in DLC now have very SEXY sound effects added to it. (SUPER SEXY)
- Fixed some minor bugs.

Besides these many updates, we also very happy to announce that a new character is coming soon.  Let's we all looking forward to it!
__________________________

P/s: Special thanks to 沙耶羽真【Saya U】for helping us improved and remade many songs' data, and morphicmetal has helped us correcting our script's typo. We are glad to have you and many other players walking down this path together with us, giving this game a chance to become more fun and enjoyable.

notes.title: Love Rhythm v1.1.0 - EASY Mode and more....
notes.content:
Hi everyone,
We now have EASY MODE in our big update - version 1.1.0. Hurray! ːsteamhappyː
What's news:
- Added EASY MODE.
- Improve gift system.
- Added mission system.
- Added Ranking Bonus for manual player.
- Added more achievements.
- Fixed some minor bugs.

In addition, we are looking for more feedback and cooperation with rhythm players to improve the experience of our rhythm gameplay. Let's stay in touch with us! ːsteamhappyː

Dev Team

notes.title: Hentai Crush - Love Rhythm v1.0.2 NOW AVAILABLE !!!
notes.content:
Hi everyone, 
We are very thankful for your support and feedback on our game. We have updated to a new version 1.0.2.

What's news:
- Balanced Auto cost and miss damage.
- Fixed battle music runs immediately after starting.
- Added Skip dialog feature.
- Added Retry option in battle pause panel.
- Fixed controller crash.
- Fixed Music/Voice/SFX control in the setting.
- Added Name Editing in the setting.
- Increased Song List mouse scroll sensibility.
- Updated tutorial.
- Fixed some minor bugs. 

In addition, we are working to add EASY MODE to the game, wishing for your best experience. Let's stay in touch with us! ːsteamhappyː

Dev Team
